text:
Search found related components, but no verified prior method combining exactly SASRec, text-similarity-weighted historical ID-embedding pooling, and a zero-initialized residual gate. [HGN](https://arxiv.org/abs/1906.09217) uses feature/instance gating and item–item interactions; [HAM](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10034966/) models historical associations with pooling and reports mean pooling outperforming max pooling in its experiments. Neither establishes the exact proposed combination. [ReZero](https://arxiv.org/abs/2003.04887) establishes zero-initialized residual scaling, so that mechanism alone offers little originality.

The closest precedent for preserving evidence strength is [DIN](https://arxiv.org/html/1706.06978v4): candidate-conditioned historical embedding sums deliberately omit weight normalization to retain interest intensity. Mathematically, dividing similarity weights by their sum erases their absolute scale: uniformly weak matches can produce the same pooled vector as strong matches. A proposed confidence-aware alternative is p = Σwᵢeᵢ/(τ + Σwᵢ), τ > 0, with nonnegative, thresholded similarities. Weak total evidence then produces a small correction. This formula is a design inference, not a verified feature of the cited methods. A zero-initialized gate preserves the baseline initially but does not itself ensure confidence calibration after training.

[RepeatNet](https://arxiv.org/abs/1812.02646) explicitly distinguishes repeat consumption from exploration; semantic similarity alone establishes relatedness, not recurrence. For unseen-item recommendations, recurrence should mean repeated historical support for a semantic interest, rather than recommending an already consumed ID. Prioritize matched ablations: mean pooling, recency pooling, normalized semantic pooling, and confidence-aware pooling, using identical residual gates. Retain support mass/count separately and compare histories with equal pooled direction but different supporting-event counts. Any originality claim should concern demonstrated confidence or recurrence handling, not pooling plus gating generally.
